calibration.source: full-cohort Dead and paired Combined scan

selection_note: Combined blue was chosen from 26 coarse and 14 fine GPU candidates. The mean blue-excess transform had better worst-field agreement and aggregate F1 than raw B or max blue-excess; cpsam diameter 22 at cellprob -3.0 was on the stable performance plateau. Dead was chosen from 15 calibrated candidates; bounded-background, cpsam_v2 diameter 22, cellprob -2.75 retained 99.5% of legacy objects while improving nuclear support and raw-signal filter retention among calibrated candidates.
